Description

Bring desk drifting to life with this Porsche-style Pocket Drift Car, designed as a fun finger-controlled drift toy for 3D printing.
The model features a widebody sports car design, large rear wing, detailed wheels and a unique finger control system mounted on the hood, allowing you to guide and slide the car across smooth surfaces using just one finger.
The model is designed with separate components for easier printing and assembly, including the body, wheels, tires and finger-control mechanism.
Perfect as a:
- Desk toy
- Finger drift car
- Fidget toy
- Mini car collectible
- Display model
- Gift for car enthusiasts
- Fun 3D printing project
The low stance, wide wheels and large rear spoiler give the model an aggressive drift-inspired appearance while keeping the design practical for 3D printing.
For the best drifting experience, use the model on a smooth desk or tabletop surface.
